_comment: Authoritative Atlas MX front tool tuning (tools/build-atlas-tools.py models), shared by server combat and client presentation. Changing any value is a gameplay change: bump WireCodec.BUILD and ship a matching hosted server release. Seconds, metres (game scale), m/s and m/s^2; heat is shared heat.

ram._comment: Passive: a ram whose closing contact lands within front_cone (cosine of the half angle) of the prow deals damage_multiplier times the ram damage with knock_multiplier times the knock-back, and the rammer takes only self_share of the return blow. Active: a press fires the hydraulic punch for punch_seconds, striking everything the extending prow reaches for punch_damage and a punch_speed (m/s) shove with punch_lift upward share.

spear._comment: A press thrusts the lance and tines for thrust_seconds; the first enemy they reach takes thrust_damage, of which an intact plate may stop only armour_share (piercing), and is impaled. Holding primary keeps it on the tines: a spring (stiffness 1/s^2, damping 1/s, capped at max_acceleration m/s^2 times heft) drags its anchor to the tine tips while the carriage lifts it (AtlasGeometry.SPEAR_LIFT) over lift_seconds. Releasing primary throws it off with a release_speed shove; it also tears free past strain_distance, after max_hold_seconds or when either bot is eliminated. hold_heat_per_second while holding.

grinder._comment: Hold primary to spin the drum up over spinup_seconds (heat_per_second while powered). Every cadence seconds of drum contact deals damage times spin; an intact armour plate on the struck face takes plate_multiplier times that (the spikes shred armour). pull (m/s per contact) drags the target into the drum. Hold secondary to raise the arms onto the target's top over raise_seconds.
